description: Trim the single clip of a generated 4s/25fps/320x240 project to [1s, 3s) and verify the OTIO projection (1 track, 1 clip, 2s duration) plus, where the adapter's render binary is present, a rendered output with duration in [1.9s, 2.1s].
notes: Structural (OTIO) invariants run for every adapter without binaries. Render invariants run only where the adapter's binary is present; results are recorded per adapter in the completion report (honest numbers, lock P5). losslesscut has no render surface — its scenario asserts the declared unsupported failure with gap gap.losslesscut-headless-cut.
